day.lesson: On a gap-down rout day (S&P futures -2%+, VIX 25+) clean 15-minute range breaks with volume are rare: zero trades is the filter working, not a failure.

swing.lesson: Earnings gap-and-hold names with a huge beat held best on a down day; small beats drifted with the market, so size the biggest beats first.
When fully invested, a new setup needs a planned sale: name which holding goes first.

long.lesson: A long-term buy needs its stop well below the price (about 18%); check every stop is under the buy before trusting a fill.

futures.lesson: Breakouts above a round number fade in a risk-off tape: buy on a 5-minute close above the level, not a touch.

options_aggr.lesson: One contract times a risk-off mood cut (0.7) rounds to zero: plan two contracts on a cheaper strike, or expect no fill on a risk-off day.

options_safe.lesson: With C$3,000 a cash-secured put needs a stock under about US$20 above its 200-day: table cheap quality names, or the cash stays parked.

crypto.lesson: One extreme-fear add per fear episode keeps cash for a deeper flush; two adds in a day left only 14% cash.
